title: Blazing Saddles
writer: Mel Brooks, Norman Steinberg, Andrew Bergman
actors: Cleavon Little, Gene Wilder, Slim Pickens
plot: In order to ruin a western town and steal their land, a corrupt politician appoints a black sheriff, who promptly becomes his most formidable adversary.
awards: Nominated for 3 Oscars. 3 wins & 6 nominations total
